title: Al madad al madad
body:
al madad al madad ya ali
berida ho ke zainab chali
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab tadap kar ye haye
ghar hamare layeen ne jalaye
bekhata taaziyane lagaye
zulm aada ne is tarha dhaaye
sab ke mushkil kusha sun hamari dua
de ghareebon ko aa kar sahare
gham ke maaron ko aa kar bachale
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh rahi hai musibat ki maari
kaisi bigdi hai kismat hamari
be-kajawa mili hai sawari
aur muqaddar mein hai aah o zaari
shaam tak ka safar berida nange sar
shaahe waala hai ab aur na akbar
zulm hi zulm hai har qadam par
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ke dada thay shaahe madina
jis ka takiya tha sarwar ka seena
dar badar hai wo baali sakina
ab to dushwaar hai uska jeena
kis se shikwa karun kisko awaaz dun
koi sunta nahi aah o zaari
aaj bekas hai zainab tumhari
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye qaidi banaye gaye hai
dar badar hum phiraye gaye hai
shaam emin aaj laaye gaye hai
koocha o dar sajaye gaye hai
zulmat e shaam mein balwa e aam mein
ghair hai koi apna nahi hai
haye koi sahara nahi hai
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera maajaya pyasa sidhara
mar gaya bhai abbas jaisa
maine aulaad ka gham bhi paaya
phir bhi shikwa zaban par na aaya
rasme parda dari mere ghar se chali
berida besahara hoon baba
kaise darbar mai jaaun baba
al madad al madad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro azadare sibte payambar
tere seene mein hai yaade sarwar
ungliyan hai teri khoon mein tar
shayar e karbala hai tu gohar
hai ye nuha tera teri dil ki sada
koi bhi gham na hoga tujhe ab
teri bakshish ki zaamin hai zainab
al madad al madad...
author: Gohar Jarchvi
